# Aloya

> Cyprus's calmest way to ride the bus — live ETAs, smart routing, and bespoke editorial design built for Nicosia, Limassol, Larnaca, Paphos, and the intercity network.

Aloya is a mobile-first transit companion for Cyprus. It fuses official GTFS data (Nicosia urban + Cyprus intercity) with live vehicle positions, Google Routes for walking guidance, and crowdsourced rider signals to give riders trustworthy ETAs and door-to-door journeys.

## Pages
- [Home](/): Plan a journey, live network pulse at a glance
- [Getting around Cyprus by bus](/guide/getting-around-cyprus): Practical public guide for visitors and residents
- [Larnaca Airport by bus](/airport/lca): Live airport coach and bus departures
- [Paphos Airport by bus](/airport/pfo): Live airport coach and bus departures

## Optional
- [Welcome](/welcome): First-run onboarding

## Open data
- [GBFS feed](/api/public/gbfs.json): Unified GBFS 2.3 feed for Cyprus micromobility — Nextbike bikes (5 cities) + Bolt e-scooter zones (Nicosia). Free to consume, CORS open. Aloya is the aggregator; upstream sources are Nextbike Cyprus and CyNAP (Cyprus National Access Point).
